title: SQL performance reading checklist
summary: Start with data volume, predicates, join strategy and the physical plan before micro-optimizing syntax.

blocks.text: Start with data volume, predicates, join strategy and the physical plan before micro-optimizing syntax.

items: Push selective predicates early when the optimizer/engine cannot already do so.
Partition pruning matters only when the filter aligns with the physical partitioning.
Avoid selecting unused wide columns in large scans.
Check spills, shuffles/exchanges, skew and repeated scans in distributed engines.

blocks.question: What should you inspect before adding an index or repartitioning data?
blocks.answer: The actual workload and physical execution plan: scan volume, selectivity, join strategy, cardinality, skew/spill, and whether the bottleneck is I/O, CPU, memory or network.
